atoms.text:
Beim Skimming geht es darum, einen groben Überblick über die Inhalte des Textes zu bekommen. Hierbei hilft, es Bilder und Überschriften anzuschauen und den Text einmal ohne Pausen durchzulesen. Unbekannte Vokabeln werden einfach mitgelesen und nicht nachgeschaut.

Anschließend kann man den Text in ein bis zwei Sätzen zusammenfassen.

instruction.text: Skimme die Texte und beantworte anschließend die Fragen.

atoms.text: Ocelots are smaller wild cats that live in South America and sometimes travel as far north as Texas. They live in rainforests and grasslands, and are usually 8 to 16 kg. They are larger than a house cat but smaller than a cheetah. Ocelots have two black stripes on their face and dark spots all over their body. Each animal has its own unique markings, like every human’s thumbprint is unique.

atoms.a: Which sentence summarizes the text best?
b: The text is about ocelots and their fur.
++The text is about ocelots, wild cats from South America, and about some of their body characteristics.
The text is about wild animals in Europe.

atoms.text: Ocelots are carnivores that eat rodents, reptiles, birds, fish and other small animals. They have extremely sharp teeth which they use to tear meat off of the bone. They aren't able to chew with these teeth, so they swallow pieces of meat whole. Ocelots also have rough tongues which help them clean off bones.

atoms.a: Which sentence summarizes the text best?
b: ++The text is about eating habits and the favourite food of ocelots.
The text is about all kind of birds and how they live.
The text is about the sleeping behaviour of ocelots.

atoms.text: Ocelots are much more active at night and prefer to stay hidden during the day, which means that they are nocturnal. Their eyes have an extra layer which helps them see better in the dark.  Ocelots spend most of their life alone and are very territorial. They only interact with other ocelots during mating season. Ocelots usually give birth to 2-3 kittens per litter.

atoms.a: Which sentence summarizes the text best?
b: The text is about the social interactions of ocelots.
The text describes the birth of an ocelot.
++The text sums up at what daytime ocelots are active and how they interact with other ocelots, especially during mating season.
